brief:
Mourners gathered in Deir al-Balah in central Gaza to bury victims of a sand collapse, according to Maan Wire. The funeral took place amid ongoing conditions in the territory that have complicated rescue and recovery operations.

Details of the incident, including the number of casualties and circumstances of the collapse, were not immediately available. Deir al-Balah has faced repeated infrastructure challenges during the conflict affecting the Gaza Strip.
title: Gaza buries victims of sand collapse in Deir al-Balah
